result.instructions: Tools for Qovery, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which environments in our production project are not running right now?"; "Show the last five deployments of the api environment and whether they failed."; "Is the database service in staging healthy, and what does its status say?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Qovery data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run qovery_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run qovery_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run qovery_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. qovery_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: qovery_list_organizations
tools.title: List organizations
tools.description: List the Qovery organizations this API token can access, with their ids. Start here to find an organization id. Qovery API: GET /organization.

tools.name: qovery_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List the projects of one organization. Each project holds environments. Qovery API: GET /organization/{organizationId}/project.

organization_id.description: The organization id (a UUID from the list tools).

tools.name: qovery_get_project
tools.title: Get a project
tools.description: Get one project by id, including its name and description. Qovery API: GET /project/{projectId}.

project_id.description: The project id (a UUID from the list tools).

tools.name: qovery_list_environments
tools.title: List environments
tools.description: List the environments (for example production or staging) of one project. Qovery API: GET /project/{projectId}/environment.

project_id.description: The project id (a UUID from the list tools).

tools.name: qovery_get_environment
tools.title: Get an environment
tools.description: Get one environment by id, including its name, cluster and mode. Qovery API: GET /environment/{environmentId}.

environment_id.description: The environment id (a UUID from the list tools).

tools.name: qovery_get_environment_status
tools.title: Get environment status
tools.description: Get the state and last deployment result of one environment (running, stopped, deploying, failed and so on). Qovery API: GET /environment/{environmentId}/status.

environment_id.description: The environment id (a UUID from the list tools).

tools.name: qovery_list_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: List every service (applications, containers, databases and jobs) of one environment in one call. Qovery API: GET /environment/{environmentId}/services.

environment_id.description: The environment id (a UUID from the list tools).

tools.name: qovery_list_applications
tools.title: List applications
tools.description: List the applications (built from Git or a Dockerfile) of one environment. Qovery API: GET /environment/{environmentId}/application.

environment_id.description: The environment id (a UUID from the list tools).

tools.name: qovery_list_containers
tools.title: List containers
tools.description: List the containers (from a registry image) of one environment. Qovery API: GET /environment/{environmentId}/container.

environment_id.description: The environment id (a UUID from the list tools).

tools.name: qovery_list_databases
tools.title: List databases
tools.description: List the managed databases of one environment. Qovery API: GET /environment/{environmentId}/database.

environment_id.description: The environment id (a UUID from the list tools).

tools.name: qovery_list_jobs
tools.title: List jobs
tools.description: List the jobs (cron or one-off tasks) of one environment. Qovery API: GET /environment/{environmentId}/job.

environment_id.description: The environment id (a UUID from the list tools).

tools.name: qovery_get_service_status
tools.title: Get service status
tools.description: Get the state, deployment status and status details of one application, container, database or job. Qovery API: GET /{type}/{id}/status.

service_type.description: Kind of service: application, container, database or job.

service_id.description: The service id (a UUID from the list tools).

tools.name: qovery_list_deployments
tools.title: List environment deployments
tools.description: List recent deployments of one environment: when they ran, who or what triggered them, and their result. Qovery API: GET /environment/{environmentId}/deploymentHistoryV2.

environment_id.description: The environment id (a UUID from the list tools).

page_size.description: Deployments per page (default set by Qovery).

tools.name: qovery_list_clusters
tools.title: List clusters
tools.description: List the Kubernetes clusters of one organization, where environments run. Qovery API: GET /organization/{organizationId}/cluster.

organization_id.description: The organization id (a UUID from the list tools).

tools.name: qovery_get_cluster_status
tools.title: Get cluster status
tools.description: Get the status of one cluster: whether it is deployed, its state and the reason for any problem. Qovery API: GET /organization/{organizationId}/cluster/{clusterId}/status.

organization_id.description: The organization id (a UUID from the list tools).

cluster_id.description: The cluster id (a UUID from the list tools).

tools.name: qovery_deploy_environment
tools.title: Deploy an environment
tools.description: Start a deployment of all services in one environment, using the latest configuration. Services may restart. Qovery API: POST /environment/{environmentId}/deploy.

environment_id.description: The environment id (a UUID from the list tools).

tools.name: qovery_stop_environment
tools.title: Stop an environment
tools.description: Stop all services in one environment. The services go offline until someone deploys them again. Qovery API: POST /environment/{environmentId}/stop.

environment_id.description: The environment id (a UUID from the list tools).

tools.name: qovery_redeploy_application
tools.title: Redeploy an application
tools.description: Redeploy one application with the same Git commit or image it runs now. Use it to rebuild or restart the app with its current source. Qovery API: POST /application/{applicationId}/redeploy.

application_id.description: The application id (a UUID from the list tools).

tools.name: qovery_restart_application
tools.title: Restart an application
tools.description: Restart the running pods of one application without a new build. Qovery API: POST /application/{applicationId}/restart-service.

application_id.description: The application id (a UUID from the list tools).

tools.name: qovery_stop_application
tools.title: Stop an application
tools.description: Stop one application. Its public URL goes offline until someone deploys it again. Qovery API: POST /application/{applicationId}/stop.

application_id.description: The application id (a UUID from the list tools).
